description: Beijing University of Technology researchers publish measurements supporting a study of pavement-marking visibility at night. Zenodo provides an Excel workbook free under CC BY 4.0, and the describing article explicitly identifies this dataset DOI. The experiment uses twenty-four drivers and fifty-four white marking combinations spanning six widths and nine retroreflectivity levels under high-beam illumination. Detection-distance observations can calibrate driver-visibility components in road-safety simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this experimental workbook. Coverage is the study conditions, not all drivers, headlamps, pavement states or weather. The small participant sample and controlled illumination constrain transfer to general traffic. Workbook column definitions, acquisition dates and measurement uncertainty require checking before numerical reuse. No workbook was downloaded or visibility relationship independently fitted.
